UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and role-based access control assignment.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in peer radar and file provenance.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Auth.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile or role was last updated.

VaultFileMetadata.title: VaultFileMetadata
VaultFileMetadata.description: Firestore audit and ownership record for a categorized vault file.

ownerUid.description: UID of the user who uploaded the file.

pinned.description: Whether file is pinned to the top of list and grid views.

pinnedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the file was pinned to top.

favorite.description: Whether file is marked as a favorite.

favoritedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the file was marked as favorite.

encrypted.description: Whether the file payload is end-to-end encrypted with AES-256-GCM.

encryptionAlgo.description: Cryptographic cipher and key derivation algorithm (AES-256-GCM / PBKDF2-SHA256).

encryptionFingerprint.description: SHA-256 integrity fingerprint of the encrypted envelope.

encryptedPayload.description: JSON serialized zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM ciphertext envelope.

keyHint.description: Optional non-secret hint for the decryption passphrase.

ownerEmail.description: Email of the user who uploaded or synced the file.

downloads.description: Number of times the file has been downloaded.

notes.description: Searchable transfer notes attached to the file.

textContent.description: Optional inline text or code content for instant preview.

dataUrl.description: Optional inline base64 data URL for small assets.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Chronological room audit log record for file uploads, deletions, and category changes.

action.description: Type of file or room operation performed.

category.description: Current or new category associated with the operation.

previousCategory.description: Previous category prior to a category change.

actorName.description: Display name of the user who triggered the operation.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when the operation occurred.

SharedBundle.title: SharedBundle
SharedBundle.description: Temporary shareable multi-file bundle record with expiration timestamp.

archiveName.description: Generated ZIP archive filename for the bundle.

createdBy.description: Display name of the user who generated the temporary bundle link.

ownerUid.description: UID of the user who created the bundle.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the bundle was generated.

expiresAt.description: ISO expiration timestamp after which the link is no longer valid.

fileIds.description: Bounded list of bundled file IDs.

fileNames.description: Bounded list of bundled file names.

fileCount.description: Number of files in the bundle.

totalBytes.description: Uncompressed total size in bytes of bundled files.

bundleZipBytes.description: Compressed ZIP archive size in bytes.

downloads.description: Number of times the bundle link has been downloaded.

revoked.description: Whether the temporary shareable link has been manually revoked.

shareUrl.description: Shareable frontend URL for the bundle.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user authentication profiles and RBAC roles (admin, editor, viewer).

/vault_files/{fileId}.description: Stores ownership and categorization metadata for shared vault files.

/activity_logs/{logId}.description: Stores chronological audit trail of file uploads, deletions, and category changes.

/shared_bundles/{bundleId}.description: Stores temporary expiring shareable multi-file bundle links.
